sources.name: NHDOT 10 Year Plan - Planning Projects (copy in The Nature Conservancy's NH_Transportation_Source_Data)
sources.authority: New Hampshire DOT (copy hosted by The Nature Conservancy)
sources.planned_filter: All records are PROJECT_TYPE 'Planning' and IS_TEN_YEAR 'YES' at the time of the copy; drop any whose L2In_Planning_AD_DATE is in the past.
sources.sample: {"L2In_Planning_PROJ_NUMBER": "29055", "L2In_Planning_PROJ_NAME": "RICHMOND", "L2In_Planning_PROJ_DESCRIPTION": "BRIDGE REPLACEMENT-WHIPPLE HILL RD OVER ROARING BROOK-BR. #065/083", "L2In_Planning_PROJECT_TYPE": "Planning", "L2In_Planning_PROJECT_DOLLARS": "     $3,414,378", "L2In_Planning_AD_DATE": 1721088000000}
sources.notes: THIRD-PARTY, STALE copy: NHDOT's own 'Projects In Planning' layer (maps.dot.nh.gov Projects/NHDOT_PROJECTS_PROPOSALS) exported by TNC; BUILD_DATE 2023-11, layer last edited 2024-03. Only the planning-stage Ten Year Plan projects (105 lines). Same schema as NHDOT's layer incl. HAS_ROW_PLANS, TYP_PROJECT_SHEET (PDF link per project), PROJECT_DOLLARS as padded text. NHDOT's own server still returns error 500 on every query, find and identify call (re-tested 2026-11-17), so this is the only copy with real records found. Use as a stopgap.

sources.name: Nashua Regional Planning Commission MPO Projects Map - Ten-Year Plan Projects (Lines)
sources.planned_filter: OBLIGATED = 'No' (not yet funded for construction); YEAR is the planned year
sources.sample: {"PROJECTNO": "42593", "LOCATION": "Future Baboosic Greenway", "SUMMARY": "Construct rail trail between Baboosic Lake Rd and Walnut Hill Rd", "TYPE": "Bike-Ped", "COST": "$852,566", "STATUS": "Active", "YEAR": "2029", "MUN": "Amherst"}

sources.name: ArDOT STIP 2023-2026 lines (STIP_2023_2026_Web_Map, real attribute fields)
sources.planned_filter: Federal_Fi >= current federal fiscal year (values 2023-2026, 0 = unscheduled). New_Locati = 1 marks new-location jobs (27 lines), Job_Type = 'Capacity' marks widening.
sources.sample: {"Job_No": "101170", "Job_Name": "Hwy. 63 \u2013 Hwy. 67 (S)", "Scope_Of_W": "Level Up & UTBWC", "Job_Type": "Pavement Preservation", "Cost_Estim": 2400, "Status": 2, "Federal_Fi": 2025, "County_No": 38}
sources.notes: Previous STIP cycle (edited 2023-09), but unlike the current 2025-2028 KML-import layer on gis.ardot.gov it has proper fields: job name, scope of work, job type (7 values), cost estimate (looks like $ thousands), federal fiscal year, new-location flag. Use it to enrich the 2025-2028 layer by Job_No (the job number is in that layer's popupinfo HTML). Layer 0 is the point version (same schema). County_No is ArDOT's county number, not a name.

sources.name: ArDOT Highway Study E-Library - study corridors (DISPLAY_LINES)
sources.planned_filter: Date >= 2018 (year of the study; 8 lines dated 2020 or later) and Document_Type in ('AHC Planning Study','Environmental','Interchange Justification Report','Toll Feasibility')
sources.sample: {"Library_Nu": "1.01.005", "Title": "Forrest City Western Bypass Feasibility Report", "Document_Type": "AHC Planning Study", "Date": 1974, "County": "St. Francis"}
sources.notes: Corridor lines for every planning, bypass, feasibility and environmental study ArDOT holds since the 1970s (346 lines), each with a PDF link (SharepointLink). Most are historical; recent ones are early signals of new-location and widening corridors (e.g. Highway 412 Corridor Planning Study Update, 2020). Layer 9 is the same as multipoints. No cost or status.

sources.name: ArDOT public-involvement design map, example: Job 012366 Springdale Bypass - Proposed Right-of-Way (one service per job)
sources.planned_filter: Every such service is a project still in design (public-involvement stage). Take the layers named 'Proposed Right-of-Way', 'Temporary Construction Easement', 'Proposed Construction Limits' and 'Potential Relocations'.
sources.sample: {"FID": 1, "Entity": "Line", "Handle": "34656C", "Layer": "R_ROW", "LyrFrzn": 0, "LyrOn": 1, "Color": 7, "Linetype": "Continuous"}
sources.notes: PATTERN SOURCE, high value for land acquisition: ArDOT publishes the CAD design of each job taken to a public meeting as its own hosted service, with the proposed right-of-way line, construction limits, easements and (here, layer 9) 'Potential Relocations' polygons. The job number is in the service name; attributes are CAD leftovers (Layer, Linetype), so join to the STIP by job number. Discover them by listing https://services.arcgis.com/7cbqsWqMe170dJ3k/arcgis/rest/services?f=json (765 services on 2026-11-17, about 115 matching Job_|ROW|Right_of_Way|Plans|VPI) and https://gis.ardot.gov/hosting/rest/services/Hosted?f=json (e.g. Job_070367_Interactive_Web_Map_Nov_2026 with 'Acquired Right-of-Way'). Service names carry the month, e.g. Job_080675_Roadway_Plans_October_2026, Job_101119_Roadway_Plans_October_2026.

sources.name: RTC Southern Nevada - All RTC Roadway Projects (Las Vegas valley)

sources.planned_filter: MPO_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND MPO_PHASE IN ('Design','Design Complete','Soon to Advertise','Advertise','Pending Construction'); record_count given is for MPO_STATUS='ACTIVE' (856 lines in total incl. completed).
sources.sample: {"RTC_PROJ_NUM": "160B-FTI2", "PROJECT_NAME": "160B-FTI2, Allen Ln - Craig Rd to Centennial Pkwy", "PROJ_DESCRIPTION": "Allen Ln - Craig Rd to Centennial Pkwy", "PROJECT_COST": 692000.0, "MPO_PHASE": "Design", "JURISDICTION": "City of North Las Vegas"}

Refreshed from RTC's project database (last_edited_date 2026-08). Layers 1 and 2 are the unjoined geometry.

sources.name: RTC Washoe 2050 Regional Transportation Plan project listing - funded lines (Reno/Sparks)

sources.name: Jackson MPO (CMPDD) 2045 Metropolitan Transportation Plan - Fiscally Constrained Capacity Projects
sources.authority: Central Mississippi Planning & Development District (Jackson MPO); projects built by MDOT, counties and cities
sources.planned_filter: All are planned widening / new-road projects. stage: 'Stage I' = nearest term, 'Stage III' = latest. funding = 'MDOT' selects state projects. improvemen LIKE 'New%' = new-location roads.
sources.sample: {"project_id": 140, "roadway": "US 80", "limits": "US 51 to MS 468", "improvemen": "Widen to 6 Lanes", "stage": "Stage III", "funding": "MDOT"}
sources.notes: First Mississippi source with geometry: Hinds, Madison, Rankin counties only. Every record is capacity work (17 improvement types such as 'Widen to 6 Lanes', 'New 4 Lane Roadway', 'New Frontage Roads'), the kind that needs right of way. Many segments per project (join on project_id); 17 of 187 segments have blank attributes (count given is the filled ones). Layer 5 = Visionary (unfunded) capacity projects, 3/4 = non-capacity. No cost or year.

sources.name: Jackson MPO (CMPDD) TIP 2025-2028 viewer - MDOT Projects
sources.authority: Central Mississippi Planning & Development District (Jackson MPO) / Mississippi DOT

sources.authority: Indiana DOT / Indiana MPOs (hosted by INDOT's STIP consultant)

sources.name: MAPA (Omaha-Council Bluffs MPO) 2050 Metropolitan Transportation Plan projects - lines
sources.authority: Metropolitan Area Planning Agency; lead agencies NDOT, Iowa DOT, Omaha, Douglas/Sarpy counties and cities

Contains past years too, so filter on year. Lead_Agency identifies NDOT projects. Edited 2025-09. Companion MTP_Projects_Point_view.

sources.name: MAPA FY2026 TIP projects - lines (Omaha-Council Bluffs)
sources.planned_filter: All programmed in the FY2026 TIP; control_num is the NDOT control number (NE-xxxxx) or Iowa DOT number.
sources.sample: {"tip_id": "2022-032", "proj_name": "33rd & Hamilton Mini Roundabout", "proj_type": "Other", "proj_cost": 648790, "geography": "Douglas"}

sources.name: Lincoln MPO 2050 LRTP roadway project prioritization - linear projects (consultant web map)
sources.authority: Lincoln MPO / City of Lincoln, Lancaster County, NDOT (hosted by the plan's consultant)
sources.planned_filter: All are candidate or committed roadway projects of the plan being written in 2026. ProjStatus LIKE 'Committed%' = funded (TIP, HSIP, local, developer); blank = candidate.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": 76, "ProjectStr": "West Beltway (US 77)", "ProjectDes": "Freeway with new interchanges", "ProjStatus": "Committed - TIP", "ProjectLea": "NDOT"}
sources.notes: 133 roadway capacity projects incl. NDOT's West Beltway (US 77) and South Beltway work; ProjectDes says e.g. 'Freeway with new interchanges', '2 lanes + turn lanes'. Proj_Limit gives limits. Layer 0 = point (intersection) projects. Third-party host, edited 2026-03; may be withdrawn when the plan is adopted. Lincoln's own TIP layer (services1.arcgis.com/wpJGOi6N4Rq5cqFv/.../TIP_Program_Projects, 535 points) is the official alternative but thin.

sources.name: NCDOT Right of Way GIS - Proposed Acquisition: ROW Left (new right-of-way polygons per parcel)
sources.authority: North Carolina DOT Right of Way Unit
sources.planned_filter: No status or date. ProjectID = STIP number + '_ROWGIS' (e.g. B5326_ROWGIS -> STIP B-5326): keep parcels whose STIP project is still in the NCDOT STIP layer (already recorded) with a right-of-way or construction year not yet past.
sources.sample: {"ProjectParcelID": "B5326_5", "ProjectID": "B5326_ROWGIS", "LevelName": "Exist Deed Draft Right of Way Left"}
sources.notes: TOP FIND for land acquisition: the actual areas NCDOT plans to acquire, as polygons per project parcel, from its right-of-way plans. One layer per take type and side: 116/117 ROW Left/Right (28,027 in 116), 120/121 temporary drainage easement, 123/124 temporary construction easement (23,059 in 123), 126/127 temporary utility, 130-149 permanent easements (construction, conservation, drainage, utility, aerial utility), 151/152 remnants, 154 Existing Parcel Shape (65,937 whole affected parcels), 106 parcel number polygons, 2 Property Owner (owner names as map annotation: TextString, e.g. an owner's name, with ProjectID; 226,755 text pieces, long names split over several). ProjectParcelID = project + parcel number (B5326_5). maxRecordCount 1000. Covers past and current projects together. Sibling folder RowMS has ProposedProperty / ProposedRoad / ExistingProperty CAD layers (e.g. 'Prop ROW Marker').

sources.name: SCDOT statewide Long Range Transportation Plan projects - corridors (LRTPCorridorProjects)
sources.authority: South Carolina DOT with the state's MPOs, COGs and sales-tax counties
sources.planned_filter: ProjectSta NOT IN ('Complete','Completed','Completed - Recently','Substantially Complete','Under Construction','Construction','Awarded'); for land: ProjectTyp IN ('Road Widening','Widening','Widenings','New Location','New Road','Extension','New Interchange','Corridor Improvement','Corridor Improvements'). ProjectSta values 'Right of Way Acquisition', 'Right-of-Way', 'ROW Acquisition' mark projects buying land now.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": " ", "Name": "Rainbow Lake Rd", "Descriptio": " ", "ProjectTyp": "Corridor Improvement", "Anticipate": " ", "ProjectSta": " ", "ProjectYr": 0, "CountyID": 42}
sources.notes: CURRENT replacement for the stale October 2023 SCDOT snapshot: edited 2026-11-02, in SCDOT's own ArcGIS Online org. Compiles long-range plan projects reported by 29 agencies (ReportingA: MPOs such as GPATS, CHATS, COATS; COGs; sales-tax counties such as Charleston, Horry, York). ProjectFun = funding (LRTP, Local Option Sales Tax...). AlreadyonP = 'Yes' means already a programmed SCDOT project (ProjectID like P031970). Values are free text entered by each agency, so 30 status spellings and 31 type spellings; Anticipate (cost) is text; many rows lack a description. Companion layers same schema: LRTPIntersectionProjects (1,580 multipoints) and LRTPBridgeProjects (265 multipoints).

sources.name: SCDOT statewide Long Range Transportation Plan projects - intersections (LRTPIntersectionProjects)
sources.planned_filter: Same as the corridor layer: drop completed / under-construction statuses.
sources.sample: {"ProjectID": "P031970", "Name": "S-37 (JP Stevens Rd) @ W Cherry & S-65 (JP Stevens Rd) @ Martin Creek Rd", "Descriptio": " ", "ProjectTyp": "Intersection Improvement", "Anticipate": " ", "ProjectSta": "Design/Development", "ProjectYr": "2027", "CountyID": 37}
sources.notes: Point (multipoint) companion to LRTPCorridorProjects, edited 2026-11-02. LRTPBridgeProjects (same org, 265 records, ProjectTyp e.g. 'New Bridge') is the bridge companion.

sources.name: PennDOT Transportation Projects - lines (Open Data, MPMS project system)
sources.planned_filter: PROJECT_STAGE IN ('IN DEVELOPMENT','FUTURE DEVELOPMENT') (14,292 of 195,320 line segments; the count recorded is for this filter). Add HAS_RIGHT_OF_WAY_PHASE = 'T' for projects with a right-of-way phase (4,834 segments). PROJECT_CLASS_NAME IN ('New Alignment','Additional Lanes','Interstate Capacity Adding','New Bridge') = 261 segments most likely to take land.
sources.sample: {"PROJECT_ID": 8, "PROJECT_TITLE": "SPF FUNDS", "PROJECT_SHORT_NARRATIVE": "MISCELLANEOUS", "PROJECT_CLASS_NAME": "Planning/Research/Administration", "EST_CONSTR_PHASE_COST_AMOUNT": 10000.0, "PROJECT_STAGE": "IN DEVELOPMENT"}
sources.notes: PENNSYLVANIA HAD NO STATE FILE AT ALL in research/states; this is PennDOT's official open-data layer and is excellent. All projects since the 1990s, one row per road segment (group by PROJECT_ID). Flags: TYP_FLAG (Twelve Year Program), TIP_FLAG, STIP_FLAG, HAS_STUDY_PHASE / HAS_PRELIMINARY_ENGINEER_PHASE / HAS_FINAL_DESIGN_PHASE / HAS_RIGHT_OF_WAY_PHASE / HAS_UTILITY_PHASE / HAS_CONSTRUCTION_PHASE ('T'/'F'). PROJECT_STATUS_CODE_DESC: Candidate, Programmed, Active, Hold, Completed, Finalled, History, Incomplete. LET_DATE (text yyyymmdd) with LET_FLAG 'E' = estimated; ESTIMATED_LET_DATE epoch ms (a few bad far-future values). MUNICIPALITY_NAMES, PLANNING_PARTNER_NAME (MPO/RPO), PROJECT_SPONSOR_NAME, PROJECT_MANAGER_CONTACT_NAME. Refreshed daily (LAST_EDITED_DATE max 2026-11-15). maxRecordCount 2000. No restriction stated.

sources.name: PennDOT Transportation Projects - points (Open Data)
sources.planned_filter: Same as the lines layer: PROJECT_STAGE IN ('IN DEVELOPMENT','FUTURE DEVELOPMENT'); count recorded is for this filter (167,378 points in all).
sources.sample: {"PROJECT_ID": 32165, "PROJECT_TITLE": "SR 2007:Thurston Road", "PROJECT_SHORT_NARRATIVE": "State Route 2007 (Hunter Road/Thurston Road) from Pettis Road to State Route 27  West Mead Township and the City of Meadville  Resurfacing", "PROJECT_CLASS_NAME": "Highway Restoration", "EST_CONSTR_PHASE_COST_AMOUNT": 400000.0, "PROJECT_STAGE": "FUTURE DEVELOPMENT", "ESTIMATED_LET_DATE": 1861920000000, "COUNTY_NAME": "CRAWFORD"}
sources.notes: Point-located projects (bridges, intersections) from the same system; field names checked against the layer by the writer script.

sources.name: UDOT Right of Way parcels (ROW_UDOTParcels_LIVE)
sources.authority: Utah DOT Right of Way Division
sources.planned_filter: PROPERTY_STATUS IN ('Acquisition' (441), 'Condemnation' (44), 'Hold For Project', 'Relocation', 'Right of Entry') = parcels in the acquisition pipeline; CORRIDOR_PRESERVATION = 'Y' (612) = land bought ahead for future corridors. Everything else (Cleared, Recorded, UDOT ROW, Excess Land, Sold...) is already owned or disposed.
sources.sample: {"PARCEL_NUMBER": "102:C", "PIN_DESCRIPTION": "Smithfield, 250 East Round-About", "PROJECT_LOCATION": "Cnty:FA-1266; MP 3.00 - 3.00 & 250 East 600 South Intersection", "PROPERTY_TYPE": "Residential", "PROPERTY_STATUS": "Acquisition", "COUNTY": "CACHE"}
sources.notes: Parcel polygons UDOT has acquired or is acquiring, 57,287 in all, with PROJECT_PIN (joins to the UDOT ePM STIP layer's PIN), PROJECT_NUMBER, ORIGINAL_OWNER (surname/owner at acquisition), SITUS_ADDRESS, TAX_ID, INSTRUMENT_TYPE, EASEMENT_DESCRIPTION, ACREAGE_GEOM. Caveat: latest ACQ_DATE is 2023-06 and latest CREATED_DATE 2024-02 although rows were edited up to 2026-11, so new acquisitions may lag; use mainly to learn which PINs take land and where corridor preservation is happening.

sources.name: MoDOT NEPA Inventory - environmental study corridors (EIS / EA / PEL)
sources.planned_filter: NEPA_CLASSIFICATION IN ('EIS','EA','PEL') (213 of 240). NEPA_APPR_DATE IS NULL (94 rows) = document not yet approved, i.e. study still open; where a date exists keep recent ones. Then check the job against the STIP layer: an approved corridor not yet in the STIP is future work.
sources.sample: {"ROOT_JOB_NUMBER": "3P0533", "DOCUMENT_NAME": "ROUTES 54, 19 AND 107 AUDRAIN, MONROE, PIKE, AND RALLS COUNTIES IN MISSOURI", "LOCATION_DESCRIPTION": "THE HIGHWAY IMPROVEMENTS WOULD EXTEND FROM U.S. ROUTE 61 NEAR BOWLING GREEN AND NEW LONDON ON THE EAST TO MARK TWAIN LAKE AND THE MEXICO BYP", "NEPA_CLASSIFICATION": "EIS", "COUNTY_NAME": "AUDRAIN"}
sources.notes: Corridors that have an environmental impact statement, environmental assessment or planning-and-environment-linkage study: the earliest public signal of new-location and widening projects. NEPA_APPR_DATE is stored as TEXT like '01-DEC-16', so it cannot be range-filtered on the server. Layer 0 'NEPA Jobs' (63 lines) ties construction job numbers and award years (CONST_AWARDYR) to these documents.

sources.name: SDDOT STIP - Unprogrammed projects: Construction Reconstruction
sources.planned_filter: All are proposed projects beyond the 4-year STIP (TranspProjectStatusCode 'Proposed'; FiscalYear/ConstructionYear '2099' = not yet scheduled; ImproveDesc often states the proposed year, e.g. 'Proposed FY2035 - Grading, Interim Surfacing').
sources.notes: Adds the long-range tail to the approved STIP layers already recorded: grading / reconstruction projects SDDOT intends but has not programmed (68 lines; layer 3 resurfacing 41, 6 safety 5). Same schema as DOT_STIP_Approved. Sibling services on the same folder: STIP/DOT_DevelopmentalSTIP_Special (layer 1 'Grading and Shoulder Widening Segments', 52 lines), STIP/DOT_STIP_Tentative (next year's draft STIP, same layers as Approved) and STIP/DOT_STIP_Needs.

sources.name: MDT Corridor Studies (planning corridor study lines)
sources.planned_filter: TYPE_ = 'Ongoing' (1 on 2026-11-17); 'Completed' studies with a recent DATE_END are corridors whose recommended projects have not been built yet.
sources.sample: {"NAME": "US 2 Badrock Canyon ", "TYPE_": "Completed", "DATE_END": 1348963200000}
sources.notes: Small (41 lines; layer 1 has 4 study-area polygons) but it is the pre-STIP signal for Montana: each row links (HYPERLINK) to the study page. Also on this server: MDTGIS/State_Transportation_Improvement_Program/MapServer (STIP Lines 2026, 275 lines; STIP Points 5), an alternative to the Tentative Construction Plan already recorded.

sources.name: IDOT Annual Highway Improvement Program - Land Acquisition
sources.planned_filter: Every record is a land-acquisition line item funded in the current annual program (RecordType 'LA', Improvem_1 'Land Acquisition'): IDOT is buying right of way at these locations this fiscal year.
sources.sample: {"PPSProject": "1818400300", "Location": "Joliet Maintenance Yard (17430 N Broadway St, Lockport)", "Improvem_1": "Land Acquisition", "EstimatedC": "100,000", "ProjectTam": "Miscellaneous Improvements"}
sources.notes: Direct right-of-way signal for Illinois (61 lines, edited 2026-10-02). EstimatedC is text dollars with commas; Route1-3 give the routes; PPSProject is IDOT's project number (joins to the Multi-Year Program layers already recorded). Sibling layers: 1 Engineering (421 lines; Improvem_1 such as 'P.E. (Phase I)' = preliminary engineering/environmental study, 'P.E. (Phase II)' = design, 'P.E. (Feasibility Study)') = projects in development before construction; 2 Construction (967 lines); 0 Bridge Improvement (2,082 points).

sources.name: IDOT Annual Highway Improvement Program - Engineering (projects in Phase I / Phase II development)
sources.planned_filter: Improvem_1 IN ('P.E. (Phase I)','P.E. (Feasibility Study)','Preliminary Engineering','P.E. (Phase II)','P.E. (Consultant Plans)') = projects being studied or designed, not yet built.
sources.sample: {"PPSProject": "1225740003", "Location": "Central AVE to Croftridge LN", "Improvem_1": "Construction Engineering", "EstimatedC": "660,000", "ProjectTam": "Reconstruction - Pavements"}
sources.notes: Phase I in Illinois is the preliminary engineering and environmental study where the footprint and land needs are set, so these lines flag projects a year or more before land acquisition appears in layer 3.

sources.name: ODOT (Ohio) STIP Projects - lines, with phases incl. right of way
sources.planned_filter: CURRENT_STIP_PERIOD_IND = 'Y' (STIP_PERIOD '2026-2029', 8,382 of 19,049 rows); add STIP_PERIOD_PROJECT_PHASES LIKE '%RW%' for projects with a right-of-way phase programmed in the STIP period (945 rows).
sources.sample: {"PID_NBR": 114223, "PROJECT_NME": "TRU GR FY2027 (Systematic)", "DESCRIPTION": "Systematic Guardrail maintenance and repair on various routes in TRU county.", "PRIMARY_WORK_GROUP_NME": "Maintenance", "TOTAL_PROJECT_ESTIMATE_AMT": 803360.0, "STIP_PERIOD_PROJECT_PHASES": "CO", "AWARD_SFY": 2027, "PROJECT_LOCALES": "TRU"}
sources.notes: Complements the TIMS 'Next 4 Fiscal Years' layers already recorded: this one says which phases are funded in the STIP period (ENV environmental, DD detailed design, RW right of way, CO construction, DBT design-build) and in which years (STIP_PERIOD_PROJECT_YEARS), plus TERMINI, sponsoring agency and MPO. Join on PID_NBR. Point version: MapViewers/STIP_Projects__Points_/MapServer/0.

sources.name: MnDOT Corridor Studies
sources.planned_filter: Status = 'Active' for studies under way; 'Complete' with a recent Fiscal_Year for corridors whose recommended projects are not yet in the CHIP layers.
sources.sample: {"Study_Title": "Hwy 11 / 71 International Falls Corridor Study", "Study_Description": "Study of Hwy 11 and Hwy 71 between the intersection of Koochiching County Road 91 to Hwy 53/Second Avenue", "Classification": "Study", "Status": "Complete", "Fiscal_Year": 2025, "County": "Koochiching"}
sources.notes: 61 study corridors (edited 2026-10-21) with a link to each study page. Earliest signal of future reconstruction / expansion corridors, ahead of the 10-year CHIP layers already recorded.

sources.name: VDOT Potential Project Pipeline corridors (study locations)
sources.authority: Virginia DOT / Office of Intermodal Planning and Investment
sources.planned_filter: LocationFurtherStudy = 'Yes' = corridor chosen for a Project Pipeline study; SYIP field shows whether a project is already programmed.
sources.sample: {"Corridor_ID": "I-64 03 (EB)", "Description": "I-64 EB from Exit 107 (Rockfish Gap Tpk) to Exit 114 (Dick Woods Rd)", "Jurisdiction": "Albemarle County", "LocationFurtherStudy": "Yes"}
sources.notes: 195 corridor polygons screened for Virginia's Project Pipeline (the studies that produce SMART SCALE applications), i.e. pre-SYIP candidates. Mostly analysis attributes (traffic, crash need scores); no cost or dates. Edited 2024-09, so it reflects that study round. Also in VDOT's org: SYIP_Legislative (2,864 lines / 3,092 points, edited 2026-06), a second copy of the SYIP, and Arterial_Management_Plans_In_Development (6 lines).

sources.name: WVDOT Corridor H sections status
sources.planned_filter: Status IN ('Preliminary Alignment','Under Design') = unbuilt sections where right of way is still to be bought; 'Open To Traffic' = done.
sources.sample: {"Layer": "Elkins to Kerens", "Status": "Open To Traffic"}
sources.notes: Tiny but specific: the state's largest new-location highway (US 48 Corridor H, Elkins to Virginia line), 15 section lines, edited 2026-08-28. Service name carries a date and will change. Related one-off design layers in the same org: 'Proposed Alts', 'Relocations' (12 building polygons), Parsons_to_Davis_Study_Area.

sources.name: GDOT GeoPI Project Hub - Projects (official statewide project lines)
sources.planned_filter: STATUS = 'Construction Work Program' (programmed, 13,948 rows) OR STATUS = 'Long Range Program' (1,158 rows); the record count given is for both. Exclude 'Under Construction', 'Complete', 'Legacy Projects', 'Rejected', 'Deferred'. Drop GEOMETRY_SOURCE = 'County Centroid' / 'Statewide Boundary' rows when real geometry is needed (6,114 programmed rows have real geometry from 'TPRO Web'). PROJECT_TYPE = 'New Construction' (602 planned rows) and work types such as widening, bypass, interchange are the land-taking ones.
sources.sample: {"PROJECT_ID": "T005933", "PROJECT_NAME": "HINESVILLE-CONSTRUCT 1,500' EXTENSION RWY 6L-PHASE III", "PROJECT_DESCR": "Project number associated with PID: AP017-9024-14(179).", "PRIMARY_WORK_TYPE": "Airport", "STATUS": "Construction Work Program", "COUNTIES": "Liberty"}
sources.notes: OFFICIAL REPLACEMENT for the small, dated GDOT STIP layer: the layer behind GDOT's GeoPI / Project Hub public project search, 91,763 lines for every GDOT project (PROJECT_ID = PI number), reloaded nightly (LOAD_DT 2026-11-15). This host (enterprisegis.dot.ga.gov) answers automated requests, unlike the GDOT server noted as blocked in the GA state file. No cost or date fields in the layer: get phase years and right-of-way dollars by PI number from the STIP data or GeoPI. ROUTE_NUMS, CITIES, COUNTIES, legislative districts, FUNDING_SOURCE, HAS_DOCUMENT. Same layer also at GeoPI/GEOPI_APP/MapServer/0. Copyright text: Georgia Department of Transportation; no use restriction stated. Sibling: GeoPI/GDOT_Estimated_ROW/MapServer/1 'GDOT State Route Estimated Right-of-Way' (7,460 polygons of existing right of way, useful to tell whether a project fits inside current ROW). The folder named STIP on this server requires a token.

sources.name: Oklahoma County Improvements for Roads and Bridges (CIRB) 5-year plan FY2027 - road projects
sources.authority: Oklahoma DOT with county commissioners (county roads and bridges)
sources.planned_filter: All are programmed county projects in the CIRB plan with base year 2027; PROGRAM_FED_YR is the programmed year. T_PROJ_WORK_DESC such as '39:GRADE, DRAIN & SURFACE', and right-of-way / utility work codes (86, 91) as in the state 8-Year Plan layer, mark land needs.
sources.sample: {"C_JOB_PIECE": 3237704, "T_PROJ_WORK_DESC": "39:GRADE, DRAIN & SURFACE", "PROGRAM_FED_YR": 2029, "PRIM_COUNTY": "67"}
sources.notes: Adds the county system to the ODOT 8-Year Work Plan layers already recorded (those cover state highways only): 926 county road segments and (layer 0) 399 county bridges, edited 2026-11-02. Same field scheme as the 8-Year Plan service (job piece number, work code); county is a number. One service per plan year (CIRB_Projects_FY2026, FY2025 ... also present), so the URL changes yearly. Layer 2 is the same lines dissolved per project.

sources.name: HDOT Project Status geometries - Design projects (ArcGIS copy of the Highways project system)
sources.planned_filter: This layer holds only projects in design (CURR_PHASE 'D'); NTP_LABEL says what NTP_DATE means (e.g. 'Scheduled Advertise Date:'). Layers 10-16 are construction-phase projects (skip).
sources.sample: {"PROJECT_ID": "0083-1054-D1C3", "PROJECT_TITLE": "KAMEHAMEHA HIGHWAY RESURFACING, LAIEWAI BRIDGE TO WAIPUHI BRIDGE (CON)", "SCOPE": "COLD PLANING, RESURFACING, REPAIR WEAKENED PAVEMENT AREAS, UPGRADE GUARDRAIL AND END TERMINALS, INSTALL PAVEMENT MARKINGS, STRIPING AND SIGN", "category": "safety", "COST_BAND": "Between $10 Mil and $15 Mil", "CURR_PHASE": "D", "NTP_DATE": "2026-10-30"}
sources.notes: ArcGIS-queryable version (refreshed daily, edited 2026-11-16) of the HDOT design-project data that the HI state file has only as a Socrata endpoint; 117 lines here versus 80 there, plus point projects in layer 1 (44). COST_BAND is a text range; PERCENT_COMPLETE is design progress; WEBLINK. Layers 3-8 are offset copies of the same lines for map display: use layer 9 only.

sources.name: TxDOT Right of Way - Proposed Parcels (ROW_ODP_Proposed_Parcels)
sources.authority: Texas DOT Right of Way Division
sources.planned_filter: PARCEL_STATUS = 'Active' AND PARCEL_STAGE IN ('New','Created','Appraised','Appraisal Reviewed','Appraisal Approved','Initial Offer','Final Offer','Pre-Litigation','Special Commissioner Phase','Trial Phase') = parcels TxDOT still has to acquire (record_count is for this filter; 12,446 polygons in all). 'Pre-Litigation', 'Special Commissioner Phase' and 'Trial Phase' are eminent-domain proceedings; 'Acquired - Deed', 'Acquired - Judgment', 'Completed' are done; PARCEL_STATUS 'Closed' / 'Cancelled' / 'Ready for Construction' are finished.
sources.sample: {"parcelunitid": "P00001974.001", "prcl_nbr": "2", "PROPERTY_TYPE": "Commercial", "PARCEL_STAGE": "Trial Phase", "COUNTY": "Zapata", "PROJECT_CSJ_NBR": "003804054"}
sources.notes: TOP FIND: the exact parcels (polygons of the part to be taken) TxDOT is acquiring, parcel by parcel, with the acquisition stage, live (layer edited 2026-11-17). PROJECT_CSJ_NBR is the construction CSJ and ROW_CSJ_NBR the right-of-way CSJ (join to TxDOT DCIS All Projects, already recorded, on its CSJ); PRCL_ID / parcelunitid are TxDOT parcel ids; DISTRICT, COUNTY; PROPERTY_TYPE (22 values: Residential, Commercial, Agriculture, Ranch...); PART_ACRG / PART_SQFT look like the parent tract size and PART_INIT / PART_SQFT_INIT the taking, check before use. No owner name: intersect with county parcels. No use restriction stated on the service. Also in TxDOT's org: Future_Interstates (74 lines, I-69 / I-27 / I-14 corridors with STAT Existing/Future) and TxDOT_Future_Texas_Toll_Roads (42 lines, 2023).

unverified.name: NDOT (Nevada) own GIS servers and eSTIP
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: /arcgis, /rhgis and /agsphs all answer HTTP 500; estip.nevadadot.com and gis.nevadadot.com did not connect. NDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services1.arcgis.com/9Y4hSlLf13E9S0Eo, 58 services listed) has no STIP, work-program or planned-project layer. No statewide Nevada source exists that a program can read today.

unverified.name: MDOT (Mississippi) GeoServer project geometry (WFS Proj_Data:FMS_PROJ_GEOM_X)
unverified.reason: MDOT's public project map (path.mdot.ms.gov/ProjMap) names this GeoServer in its script, but the server answered HTTP 403 Forbidden to a direct request, so it is not open to automated readers; no further attempts made. The map itself lists only 'Under Construction' and 'Construction Complete' projects. No ArcGIS service for MDOT exists (gis.mdot.ms.gov does not connect, maps.mdot.ms.gov returns 500). Mississippi statewide remains a gap; STIP is a PDF.

unverified.name: KDOT WinCPMS / Projects KHUB (official Kansas project layers)
unverified.reason: Listed on ArcGIS Online by owner KanDOT (modified 2025-12-11; also APPS/WinCPMS_KHUB/MapServer and wfs.ksdot.org/.../Transportation/WinCPMS/MapServer/0), but kanplan.ksdot.gov, kanplan.ksdot.org and wfs.ksdot.org did not resolve or connect from the research machine or from a second fetch service on 2026-11-17. Likely the right official source; retest from another network.

unverified.name: NDOT (Nebraska) Program Book 2027 layers
unverified.reason: Confirmed as the data behind NDOT's public 'Program Book 2027' web app (ArcGIS Online item 6f5b199003864bbb83586221a08c7a74 references layers 0 and 1 of this service; a sibling RightOfWayDOT/FeatureServer 'Right of Ways of Nebraska' also exists). gis.ne.gov resolves through public DNS to 164.119.176.149 but the connection timed out on every attempt, and a second fetch service could not resolve it; NDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services6.arcgis.com/ljihus0RxqhjsxEd) holds only 4 unrelated services. Retest from another network: this is almost certainly the right source.

unverified.name: NHDOT project layers (Projects In Planning / In Design / Ten Year Plan / ROW projects)
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: layer definitions answer but query, find and identify all return error 500 on every Projects service (NHDOT_PROJECTS_ALL, _PROPOSALS, _PROPOSALS_ROW, _BY_TYPE). Server-side fault at NHDOT; the stale third-party copy recorded under sources is the stopgap.

unverified.name: Rhode Island current STIP (FFY2022-2031) GIS
unverified.reason: Not found. The RIDOA folder (17 services) still has only the FFY18-27 STIP map services; the RIDOT folder has assets only (Bridge, Rhodeways, signs); RIDOT's ArcGIS Online org (services5.arcgis.com/JfTJE9T2RFfUZzVx, 44 services) has sweeping, bridge condition and municipal road-fund layers but no STIP; Statewide Planning's org has only the small LRTP ProposedProjects_Line already recorded. The current STIP is published through an e-STIP web application without an open GIS feed.

unverified.name: TDOT production server (Projects_Public_Viewer, STIP_Projects)
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: still no connection from the research machine (the test host tspatial.tdot.tn.gov, already recorded, answers). TDOT's ArcGIS Online org has no project layer.

unverified.name: CDOT 'Projects (all types)' open-data layers
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: no connection. Alternatives seen in CDOT's ArcGIS Online org but older than the layers already recorded: 10_Year_Plan_Project_Lines (283 lines, edited 2025-05), Pipeline_Project_Lines (294, 2024).

unverified.name: Louisiana DOTD project services
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: HTTP 403 to automated requests. Only third-party snapshots exist on ArcGIS Online (a consultant's 'LADOTD projects scheduled to be let in SFY 2023-2024', a 2022 'DOTD Highway Priority Program' copy): too old to record.

unverified.name: ADOT (Arizona) statewide Five-Year Program / eSTIP
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: HTTP 403. estip.azdot.gov answers as a web page only; no ADOT planned-project feature service was found on ArcGIS Online by name search. Arizona statewide remains a gap (MAG TIP for Phoenix is the only layer).

unverified.name: INDOT own GIS server
unverified.reason: Re-tested 2026-11-17: HTTP 403 from two different networks. No official INDOT replacement for the consultant-hosted STIP layer.

unverified.name: MDOT (Michigan) 2026-2029 STIP feature service
unverified.reason: Listed on ArcGIS Online by owner MDOT_GIS (modified 2026-07-30) but the server returned HTTP 403 to a direct request. Would add the federally programmed STIP (incl. local-agency projects) to the Five-Year Program layers already recorded.

unverified.name: ALDOT / NMDOT / Caltrans statewide current planned-project layers
unverified.reason: Nothing better found than what the state files already hold. ALDOT's public server (35 services) has only the undated GeoGISProjects inventory, a 'ProposedRoutes' layer (81 lines, last changes dated 2010) and scanned right-of-way map indexes (ROW_Services/EGIS_ROW, historical). NMDOT's org (213 services) has no eSTIP layer newer than FFY2025. Caltrans' org has district-only layers (D01_Future_Projects / Future_Projects_gdb for District 1, 101 lines edited 2026-09; District 5 SHOPP PID 2024) but no statewide SHOPP/STIP line layer.

summary: Checked 2026-11-17. 35 verified sources across 24 states (AR, GA, HI, IA, IL, IN, KS, MN, MO, MS, MT, NC, NE, NH, NV, OH, OK, PA, SC, SD, TX, UT, VA, WV; Iowa only through the Omaha MPO layers). GAP STATES: Arkansas - found proper-field STIP 2023-2026 layers, the highway study library and ArDOT's per-job public-involvement design services with proposed right-of-way lines. Nevada - no statewide source (NDOT servers return HTTP 500); covered Las Vegas (RTC Southern Nevada roadway projects and RTP) and Reno (RTC Washoe RTP). Mississippi - no statewide source (MDOT GeoServer refuses requests with 403); covered the Jackson MPO plan and TIP only. Nebraska - NDOT Program Book service confirmed but unreachable from here (DNS/connection failure); covered Omaha (MAPA MTP and TIP) and Lincoln (LRTP). New Hampshire - NHDOT server still errors on every query; only a stale 2023 third-party copy of the planning-stage Ten Year Plan projects plus the Nashua MPO layers. WEAK STATES: Georgia fixed (official GDOT GeoPI project layer, 91,763 lines, on a host that answers); South Carolina fixed (current statewide LRTP corridor/intersection/bridge layers, edited 2026-11); Pennsylvania, which had no state file at all, now has PennDOT's official project lines and points with a right-of-way-phase flag; Kansas, Indiana and Rhode Island not fixed at state level (official KDOT host unreachable, INDOT returns 403, no current RI STIP GIS) - added Wichita TIP, Indianapolis MTP and a partial INDOT STIP/TIP layer with phases. LAND-ACQUISITION LAYERS (best finds): TxDOT proposed right-of-way parcels with acquisition stage including condemnation stages; NCDOT proposed acquisition polygons per parcel (right of way and every easement type); UDOT right-of-way parcels with status; IDOT annual program Land Acquisition and Phase I/II engineering layers; Ohio STIP phases incl. RW; MoDOT NEPA study corridors; MnDOT and Montana corridor studies; VDOT project-pipeline corridors; SDDOT unprogrammed projects; Oklahoma county (CIRB) plan; WVDOT Corridor H; ArDOT per-job proposed ROW. NOT COVERED: additional-layer sweep was done by listing each DOT's known server/ArcGIS Online org and checking name matches; states whose project layers sit on servers I could not list (Wisconsin, North Dakota, Kentucky folders, Illinois gis1) and DOTs with a second server not named in the state files were not swept. Maryland, New Jersey, New York, Washington, Oregon, Florida, Connecticut, Delaware, Maine, Vermont, Wyoming, Iowa, Idaho, Alaska, Michigan: swept, nothing materially better than what is already recorded (minor leads are named in notes). One request to MDOT Mississippi's GeoServer with an added referer header was blocked by the tool's safety check and not retried, since the server had already refused direct access.
